askAgentSeatOnly: Only an AI teammate seated in this room can ask questions
channelArchiveOpenTasks: This channel still has open tasks. Close them before archiving it
channelArchivedNoJoin: This channel is archived and can't be joined
channelDeletedCannotUnarchive: This channel was deleted and can't be brought back
channelGeneralNoLeave: General includes everyone in the project and can't be left
channelGeneralNoManager: General is managed by the project's managers and has no manager of its own
channelGeneralNotPrivate: General includes everyone in the project and can't be made private
channelJoinToPost: Join this channel to post in it
channelManagerOnly: Only the channel's manager and the project's managers can manage this channel
channelManagerPersonOnly: A channel's manager must be a person in the project
channelPublicProjectManagerOnly: Only the project's managers can make a private channel public
channelSpeakersOnly: Only some roles can post in this channel's main line
contributorMustBeUser: A contribution credit must name a real user: {handle}
cursorNeedsLimit: after and around must be used with limit
cursorOneAnchor: Use only one of before, after, or around at a time
deleteChannelSignIn: Sign in to delete a channel
messageOrAttachment: Type a message or add an attachment
noDefaultModel: This project has no default model available. Check the model service
privateChatHasNoTasks: A direct chat has no tasks; create one in a channel
privateChatHasNoThreads: A direct chat has no threads; start one in a channel
privateChatProjectMembersOnly: Can't start a direct chat with someone outside this project
privateChatTwoPeopleOnly: Can't add members to a direct chat
projectAiTeammateNotFound: This project has no such AI teammate
projectHasNoCheese: This project doesn't have Cheese yet, so this room can't tell who “I” am
projectRootCannotArchive: The project itself can't be archived
projectRootCannotDelete: The project itself can't be deleted
roomUnderRoomUseSplit: What goes under a channel is a task, not another channel. Create a task instead
sinceAfterUntil: since can't be later than until
sinceUntilIso: since/until must be an ISO-8601 time
sourceTopicInvalid: source_topic_id isn't a valid channel ID
taskModelUnavailable: The model {model} this task is bound to isn't available in this project. Choose another one
taskNotFoundInRoom: This task isn't in this channel
taskOwnSessionSpeaks: An AI teammate speaks in a task only from that task's own conversation. To tell the task something, tell its owner in the conversation you are in
taskTeammateNeedsSeat: This AI teammate isn't in the task's channel, and you can't add it. Ask a channel manager to add it first, then give it the task
threadIdInvalid: thread must be the ID of a thread
threadOnlyUnderChannelMessage: Replies in a thread can only go under a message in a channel
threadOpenedByPerson: Only a person can start a thread
threadTitleRequired: A thread needs a name — write one line and create it
topicAddProjectMembersOnly: Only project members can be added
topicArchivedDocFrozen: This channel is archived. Its document is frozen and can't be edited
topicArchivedFrozen: This channel is archived. Unarchive it to turn a message into a task
topicCloneIntoSelf: A channel can't be cloned into itself
topicCloneNeverRan: The source channel's AI teammate hasn't worked yet, so there's no work record to clone
topicCloneRecordMissing: The source channel's AI teammate work record is missing or empty, so it can't be cloned
topicCloneSameProject: Work records can only be cloned within the same project
topicMemberAlready: This member is already in the channel
topicMuteUntilPast: The end of a mute must be in the future
topicNotifyLevelInvalid: Choose one of the three notification levels
unarchiveWhileSessionStopping: The channel's AI teammate is stopping and saving its record. You can unarchive once that's done
threadRestoreNotYours: Only whoever started this thread, or a channel admin, can restore it
threadRestoreSignIn: Sign in to restore this thread
addressingChanged: This message would no longer go to an AI teammate, so it was not sent
chatTaskUnknown: This channel has no task {task}. Its tasks are listed in the section on the channel's open tasks.
coordinateFromMainLine: Only a channel's main line coordinates tasks this way.
coordinateOwnTasksOnly: The main line closes or reopens only the tasks it opened.
coordinateTellClosed: This task has ended and takes nothing more. Reopen it to go on.
coordinateCloseWhileReviewWaits: This task has a delivery waiting for review and cannot be closed: closing would void it, which is the reviewer's decision.
coordinateAcceptNothingWaiting: This task has no delivery waiting for review.
coordinateAcceptReviewerWordOnly: You can adopt for a reviewer only in a turn that {reviewer} started by asking for it. Tell {reviewer} the delivery is waiting for their review.
coordinateAcceptNewerDelivery: This version was handed in after {reviewer} sent that message, so they have not seen it. Tell {reviewer} the new version is waiting for their review.
chatRepliesMainLineOnly: Quick replies are for a channel's main line only; to ask for an answer in a task or a thread, ask a question.
reportFromOwnTask: Only a task's own session reports to the main line.
reportNotOpenedByMainLine: This task was not opened from the main line, so there is no one to report to; ask in the task itself.
teammateTaskNotNamed: Only an AI teammate a member named can take this task: {teammate} was not named in this message.
